_comment: Single source of truth for Discord author identity. Consumed by BOTH src/lib/discord/identity-map.ts (runtime: display relabel + search scoping) and scripts/discord-clean.mjs (build-time: content rebuild + @mention resolution). Keyed by Discord author snowflake. `canonical` is the label shown everywhere; `aliases` are every other string that refers to this person (archived handle, UDM display name, nickname) — used to relabel line prefixes, resolve @mentions, and scope searches by name. Aliases MUST be unique across people (two Brocks => 'Brock' vs 'Brock 2'). Owner-curated.
